alerts.summary: pip prior to v26.2.2 the certifi bundled with pip contains the compromised eMudhra certificates. Upgrading to a secure version of pip should be done either by first upgrading Python to a version that rejects the compromised intermediates (CVE-2026-115557) or use hash pinning with a known-secure version of pip. pip is not vulnerable when using a Python version that rejects the compromised certificates. See the references below for more information.

alerts.summary: ### Summary A remote Denial of Service (DoS) vulnerability, allows any remote client to cause a complete crash of the Aedes MQTT broker process. This is achieved by sending a specially crafted MQTT message (via PUBLISH or SUBSCRIBE), or by setting a Will message with such a topic, containing a highly recursive topic string (e.g., with thousands of '/' delimiters). The lack of input validation and error handling leads to an uncaught exception in an internal routing library, terminating the entire Node.js application. ### Details The Aedes broker fails to enforce limits on the depth or structural complexity of MQTT topic strings. alerts.summary: # Summary `svg2rlg()` expands `<use>` references without any limit on the total number of expansions. Only direct cycles are rejected (`CircularRefError`). A group containing N `<use>` elements that point to another such group multiplies the work by N per nesting level, so an SVG of about 1.4 KB makes svglib clone and render over 100,000 nodes, taking tens of seconds of CPU time and hundreds of MiB of memory. alerts.summary: ## Description ### Summary A **low-privileged application end-user** (role `BASIC` - **not** a builder or admin, and on a public data-collection form, an unauthenticated visitor) can store an HTML/JavaScript payload in ordinary row data. When a **builder or admin** later opens that table in the Budibase Builder and evaluates any Handlebars binding whose Preview surfaces the value (the Data-section **Formula** column editor, or any binding drawer), the stored value is rendered as **raw HTML** and the attacker's JavaScript executes in the Builder's origin. The Builder SPA is served by nginx with **no Content-Security-Policy** (the CSP middleware only decorates the server-rendered *published-app* document, not `/builder/`). The injected script therefore runs unrestricted in the highest-trust surface of the product - the admin/builder session that can create datasources, run server-side Java

alerts.summary: ## Description ### Summary On a self-hosted, single-tenant Budibase instance (`multiTenancy:false`), the public bootstrap endpoint `POST /api/global/users/init` remains fully exploitable **after** the instance has been provisioned. Its "already initialised" guard (`checkAnyUserExists()`) is evaluated inside a **tenant-scoped** database context derived from an **attacker-controlled `tenantId`** in the request body. Because the tenancy layer never constrains that `tenantId` to the only legitimate tenant (`default`) on a single-tenant deployment, an unauthenticated attacker simply supplies any unused tenant name to make the guard see an empty user list, and the endpoint then creates a brand-new CouchDB database (`<tenantId>_global-db`) and a **global-admin** user document (`admin.global = true`, `builder.global = true`) inside it - with no authentication and no CSRF token. This is (a) a byp
